name: receiver_kv_utility_hotpotqa_overnight_seed1234
training: Only small CPU utility estimators; Llama, Qwen and Stage-A/B frozen; no Reader
scope: New document-disjoint controlled HotpotQA bridge questions. Train/calibration from official train shard; test from official dev. All previously prepared known Hotpot IDs and document titles excluded. Gold selects complete paragraphs and supplies offline labels only.
primary_metric: F1 net gain, EM secondary; independently report EM utility models
selector: Output confidence, paired candidate cross-scoring, and receiver-only KV perturbation responses. Selector hyperparameters and threshold calibrated before independent test inference; no access to original evidence, native KV, gold NLL, or corruption identity.
primary_comparison: utility_stability8 versus utility_output, utility_cross, calibrated_confidence, and question_gain on the fixed equal clean/wrong/partial50 mixture; unknown corruptions are held-out stress tests
